triples.subject: semselect.semsource.typescript.semsource-ui.function.ui-src-lib-state-readiness-ts-deriveReadinessCoverage
triples.object:
Derives an overall-readiness verdict from ALL THREE readiness signals, not
just the backend's own `overall` field (which only gates on source and
structural index) — the missing gate is exactly how "Ready" could show
while the semantic index is still building (D4). A signal that is not
advertised (`available: false`, e.g. a tier that isn't deployed) does not
block readiness; one that is advertised and not yet ready does.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.typescript.semsource-ui.function.ui-src-lib-state-readiness-ts-isFullyReady
triples.object: Whether the workbench, as a whole, needs no further self-healing poll.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.typescript.semsource-ui.interface.ui-src-lib-state-readinessPoller-ts-ReadinessPoller
triples.object:
Drives a self-healing refresh while the workbench is not ready: starts a
repeating timer the moment `sync(true)` is observed, stops it the moment
`sync(false)` is observed, and starts a fresh one if readiness regresses
(D4). Framework-agnostic and directly testable, matching the
`state/bootstrap.ts` controller style.
